characters.name: Werner
characters.pose: Standing upright and centered at the junction, facing forward with both arms extended outward
characters.action: Commanding gesture with arms spread: left arm extended toward left lane (Verena), right arm extended toward right lane (Uschi)
characters.expression: Direct gaze, authoritative presence, sharp focus

characters.name: Verena
characters.pose: Standing with body angled to the left, mid-turn posture, head and torso pivoting toward left lane
characters.action: Turning/pivoting toward the left lane (Engelgasse direction) in response to Werner's direction
characters.expression: Focused attention, acknowledging direction, eyes clear and alert

characters.name: Uschi
characters.pose: Standing ready, body angled toward the right lane, facing right direction
characters.action: Standing prepared and attentive on the right side, ready to take her assigned position
characters.expression: Calm readiness, focused determination, eyes open and engaged

fullData.imageSummary: Werner stands at the center of a cobblestone street junction with both arms extended outward in a commanding gesture. To his left, Verena stands mid-turn toward the left lane. To his right, Uschi stands facing the right lane. Medieval Altstadt buildings rise on both sides, and the ruins of Stein castle are visible on the hillside above. Afternoon light casts long shadows down both diverging street lanes.

fullData.translatedSummary: Werner steht in der Mitte einer Kopfsteinpflaster-Strassenkreuzung mit beiden Armen ausgestreckt in einer befehlenden Geste. Zu seiner Linken steht Verena und wendet sich dem linken Gässchen zu. Zu seiner Rechten steht Uschi und schaut in Richtung des rechten Gässchens. Die mittelalterliche Altstadt erhebt sich auf beiden Seiten, und die Ruine Stein ist auf dem Hügel oben sichtbar. Nachmittagslicht wirft lange Schatten auf die Kopfsteinpflaster-Gasse.
